episode.title: Learn Fruit Names & Colors | Yummy Fruits for Kids | Thumpy Meadow
episode.description_intro: Learn fruit names and colors with Dino! Apple, banana, orange, strawberry, grapes, pear, and watermelon — all in one fun video for toddlers and preschoolers.
learning_points: Name seven fruits: apple, banana, orange, strawberry, grapes, pear, watermelon
Connect each fruit to its color
Answer 'What fruit is this?' and 'What color is it?'
Practice simple English words in a playful way

segments.text: Hello, friends! I am Dino. Welcome to Thumpy Meadow!
Today we are going to learn about fruits. Yummy fruits!
We will learn their names and their colors. So exciting!
Are you ready? Let's go, friends! Here we go!
Our first fruit is here! Look at this. What is it?
It is an apple! Can you say apple? Apple!
Great job! Now, what color is the apple?
The apple is red! Can you say red? Red!
The apple is red. Red apple! Well done, friend!
Now look! A new fruit is coming. What is this?
It is a strawberry! Can you say strawberry? Strawberry!
Strawberry is red too! Can you see the color?
The strawberry is red. Red strawberry! Wonderful!
Let's count some apples together! One apple. Can you say one?
Two apples! One, two. Two red apples. Nice counting!
Three apples! One, two, three. You are so good!
Apple is red. Strawberry is red. Two red fruits! Amazing!

lines: Apple, apple, red and round,
The yummiest fruit to be found!
Strawberry, strawberry, red as can be,
Come and sing along with me!
Red, red, what a color so bright,
Red fruits make the day feel right!

segments.text: A new fruit is here! Look carefully. What could it be?
It is a banana! Can you say banana? Banana!
What color is the banana? Hmm, can you guess?
The banana is yellow! Can you say yellow? Yellow!
Yellow banana! The banana is yellow. Great answer, friend!
Now here comes another fruit. What is this one?
It is a pear! Can you say pear? Pear!
The pear is green! Can you say green? Green!
Green pear! The pear is green. You are doing so well!
Banana is yellow. Pear is green. Two yummy fruits!
Let's count bananas! One banana. One! Can you say it?
Two bananas! One, two. Two yellow bananas. Wonderful!
Which do you like: banana or pear? Tell a friend!

lines: Banana, banana, yellow and long,
Sing the yellow fruit song!
Pear, pear, so green and sweet,
A lovely little fruit to meet!
Yellow, green, what colors we see,
Fruits are as happy as can be!

segments.text: Ooh, look! A round and bright fruit is here. What is it?
It is an orange! Can you say orange? Orange!
And the color? The orange is orange! Orange colored!
The fruit and the color have the same name! So fun!
Can you say orange again? Orange! You are amazing!
Now, look at these little round fruits. What are they?
They are grapes! Can you say grapes? Grapes!
What color are the grapes? Hmm, let's look together!
The grapes are purple! Can you say purple? Purple!
Purple grapes! The grapes are purple. So pretty!
Let's count oranges! One, two, three oranges together!
Orange is orange. Grapes are purple. Two more fruits!
Can you say both? Orange! Grapes! You are a star!

lines: Orange, orange, round and bright,
An orange color, what a sight!
Grapes, grapes, purple and small,
The prettiest color of them all!
Orange and purple, can you say?
We love learning fruit today!

segments.text: We have one more fruit! This one is very big. Ready?
It is a watermelon! Can you say watermelon? Watermelon!
Watermelon is a long word! Let's say it slowly. Wa-ter-me-lon!
What color is the watermelon outside? Look carefully!
The outside is green! Can you say green? Green!
And inside the watermelon? The inside is red! So colorful!
Green outside, red inside. Watermelon! Isn't that cool?
Let's count some stars while we celebrate! One star!
Two stars! One, two. Two shiny stars for you!
Three stars! One, two, three! You learned all the fruits!
Watermelon is our last fruit today. Big and yummy!
Can you say watermelon one more time? Watermelon! Yes!

lines: Watermelon, watermelon, big and wide,
Green outside and red inside!
Watermelon, watermelon, what a treat,
A big green fruit you love to meet!
Green and red, two colors we know,
Watch the watermelon grow and glow!

segments.text: Great work today, friends! Let's remember all our fruits!
First: apple! The apple is red. Can you say apple?
Strawberry! The strawberry is red too. Strawberry!
Banana! The banana is yellow. Can you say banana?
Pear! The pear is green. Can you say pear? Pear!
Orange! The orange is orange. Orange! What a fun word!
Grapes! The grapes are purple. Can you say grapes?
Watermelon! Green outside, red inside. Watermelon!
You did it, friend! You learned seven fruits today! Hooray!
Apple, banana, orange, strawberry, grapes, pear, watermelon!
You are so clever! Dino is very proud of you today!
See you next time at Thumpy Meadow! Bye-bye, dear friend!
